name: Turoths
note: Ordinary Dad Turoth gear baseline: leaf-bladed melee, compatible broad ammunition or Magic Dart. Other family sizes and the superior are available in monster search. 55 Slayer is checked separately; task, incoming damage and trip supplies are not simulated.

name: Kurasks
note: Ordinary Kurask gear baseline: leaf-bladed melee, compatible broad ammunition or Magic Dart. Big/superior variants are separate monster-search targets. 70 Slayer is checked independently from gear; task, incoming damage and trip supplies are not simulated.

name: Tormented Demons
note: Shielded hybrid gear baseline with explicit protection-prayer states sharing 600 HP. Demonbane/abyssal shield exceptions apply. Guaranteed-accuracy shielded-defenceless state is separate; unshielded speed-bonus attacks, rotation, spawn interactions and incoming damage remain unverified.

name: Doom of Mokhaiotl
note: Deep-delve ranged/ordinary melee body and a separate 500-point demonbane shield probe. Gear screening requires ranged and melee, then checks the best usable owned melee, ranged or Magic demonbane shield route. Delves 1–8, burrow charge, shield and per-splat melee-punish bonus are separate comparisons. Charge/cooldown timing, larvae, acid, incoming damage and full-fight supplies remain unverified.

name: Maggot King
note: Heavy-ranged far phase plus a reachable melee comparison share one 1,500-HP pool. Roar and timed crush punish are alternative probes. Readiness requires ranged and melee; fire burn, phase allocation, larvae, healing, free attacks, bile and incoming damage are not simulated.

name: Mad Angel
note: Post-quest ordinary outgoing model with separate successful melee counterattack probes. Gear readiness assumes no counter bonus. Reflected blasts, enrage, free attacks, movement and incoming damage remain unverified.

name: Shellbane Gryphon
note: Post-quest ordinary outgoing model with air weakness. Gear screening equips an owned tortugan shield and flags its absence separately from the 51 Slayer requirement. Task/quest access, equipment weight, free knockback counters, corrosion, whirlwinds and incoming damage are not simulated.

name: Sol Heredit
note: Sol-only ordinary outgoing and gear baseline. Full Colosseum waves, invocations, perfect counters, grapples, positioning and incoming damage are not assessed.

name: TzKal-Zuk
note: Zuk-only exposed-window outgoing and ranged gear baseline. Full Inferno waves, shield uptime, adds, healers, positioning and incoming damage are not assessed.

name: The Hueycoatl
note: Reviewed base-stat body/head probes and one 300-HP tail. Tail caps, strict crush bonus priority, earth spells, dragonbane and explicit lit-pillar alternatives share the same outgoing rules. Team scaling, segment counts/regeneration, actual head/tail transitions, pillar activation/uptime, incoming damage and full-trip supplies remain outside this screen.

name: The Leviathan
note: Normal post-quest outgoing comparisons. Ordinary and stunned-front attacks are reviewed; rear Magic is a one-attack alternative. Enrage/pathfinder and rear ranged procs remain gated, with no full-fight incoming or timing prediction.

name: The Whisperer
note: Normal post-quest body plus the separate 140-HP heal/enrage, with independent debuff assumptions. Special reductions are alternative body comparisons. Sanity, souls/healing, special uptime, tentacles and incoming attacks are not a complete encounter model.

name: Nightmare
note: Base one-to-five-player comparison only: three 2,000-point shields and twelve 300-charge totems. Damage counters are not physical boss HP. Larger teams, stat recovery, healing, adds, movement and incoming attacks remain unverified.

name: Phosani's Nightmare
note: Solo outgoing workload: three 400-point shields, twelve 200-charge totems and a separate 150-HP final stand. Crush guarantees maximum hits against the reviewed husks/weakened parasite; spawn counts, healing, stat recovery, spores, movement and incoming attacks are not simulated.

name: Barrows Chests
note: All six brothers share one packing pool. Use the Barrows preset for its spade and spell-supply requirements; this editable group does not simulate crypt prayer drain or Verac's passive.

name: Tombs of Amascut
note: Editable solo room and style template. Use the ToA preset for its invocation setting and tools. Wardens, Akkha protection rotations, path levels, team scaling, raid potions and full encounter supply use are not fully modelled.

name: Moons of Peril
note: Defence-aware normal-attack model: chained hits, Blood healing, and flat armour. Gather food and potions inside. Curses, special phases and movement are not fully simulated.

name: Chambers of Xeric
note: Select the combat and puzzle rooms present in your layout; both Olm hands and the head stay together. Raid scaling, specialised room mechanics, elemental spells and resource requirements are not fully modelled. Editable starting styles are packing suggestions, not a validated complete raid loadout.

name: Theatre of Blood
note: Editable normal-mode packing template. Party scaling, immunities, Dawnbringer, nylocas rotations and special phases need dedicated models; no full-raid DPS claim.

name: Dagannoth Kings
note: Reviewed outgoing attacks and separate normal incoming scenarios for each King, including matching protection prayers. Three bosses share one carried pool; overlapping aggro, Spinolyps, poison, safespots, respawns and full-trip supplies are not simulated.

name: Grotesque Guardians
note: Reviewed vulnerable outgoing windows: Dawn reach restrictions, Dusk melee-only damage and first-form flat armour. Dusk's forms share one comparison HP pool with equal allocations; actual thresholds, invulnerability, lightning, healing and incoming damage are not simulated.

name: The Royal Titans
note: Reviewed close/withdrawn titan attacks and individual elemental adds. Withdrawn ranged rolls gain six times accuracy; elemental Magic has its own equipment-bonus formula. Both titan states share their respective HP pools. This gear screen needs melee, ranged and Magic; no charge/barrier uptime, add count, solo/duo contribution, incoming sequence or full-fight timing is inferred.

name: Abyssal Sire
note: Exposed respiratory systems have minimum-hit and successful Demonbane finisher rules; four 50-HP vents share the trip. Vulnerable body windows allocate 425→210→140→0 HP for comparison. Phase-1 stunning/protection, transition reduction, reset safeguards, regeneration, summons, incoming damage and movement remain unverified.

name: Alchemical Hydra
note: Four neutralised outgoing stages share one 1,100-HP workload. Combat also offers each first-three-form state before chemical weakening, with 75% damage reduction per hitsplat. Vent timing, wrong-vent boosts, poison/fire, incoming protection rotations, movement and full-fight supplies remain unverified.

name: Kalphite Queen
note: Reviewed outgoing attacks and separate incoming basic scenarios for both forms. Her ranged/magic attacks always pass accuracy and matching protection blocks HP damage; stab uses ordinary accuracy. Overheads do not grant outgoing style immunity. Attack mixtures, ranged prayer drain, workers, movement and full-fight timing remain unverified.

name: Zulrah
note: Reviewed outgoing reach and hit-cap rules for all three forms, including bolt procs. Forms share one 500-HP comparison pool with equal allocations; this is not a rotation prediction. Movement, rotations, venom, snakelings, incoming damage and full-fight supplies remain unverified.

name: Phantom Muspah
note: Reviewed unshielded outgoing forms use recorded defences, air weakness and a 125 Defence drain floor. The unshielded forms share 723 comparison HP; the final stand has 127. These allocations do not simulate the damage/four-hit form thresholds. Prayer-shield damage, freezes, step-back timing, spikes/healing, incoming attacks and full-fight supplies remain unverified.

name: The Fractured Archive
note: Five-boss route packing template: Archive Guardian, one boss room at each of three forks, and all Ocellus phases. Change each fork to match your route. Attack styles are editable starting suggestions; scaling, immunities, transformations, adds and supply use are not fully verified, so outgoing DPS is withheld for every room.

name: Fight Caves
note: Enemy-type packing template, not 63 simulated waves. Wave counts, spawn positions, protection timing, healers and sustained trip supplies are not fully modelled.

name: Inferno
note: Enemy-type packing template only. Wave counts, positioning, protection timing, shield movement, Zuk mechanics, healing and full-trip supplies are not fully modelled.

name: Fortis Colosseum
note: Editable enemy-type packing template. Wave counts, reinforcements, invocations, protection sequences, Sol's special mechanics and supply consumption are not fully modelled.

name: Yama
note: Normal Yama: slash boss windows, mandatory alternating Magic/melee Judge attacks, and an explicit one-pair Magic flare probe. Boss progress is split 1,667/833 HP; the two 400-HP Judges use the paired complete-set attack-cycle estimate. One 140-HP flare pair is a comparison assumption, not a spawn-count prediction. Demonbane vulnerability is 120% on Yama and 200% on flares. Incoming damage, movement, glyphs, environmental Judge damage, regeneration and contracts remain unmodelled. Internal window keys identify states of source NPCs, not different game NPC IDs.
